code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed KS weak-current benchmarks; no production source is configured.
scope: Leading long-distance single-electromagnetic-current KS to pi0 A-prime benchmark. The VMD shape is an explicit assumption, not a measured spectrum or a KL amplitude. Production branching excludes the A-prime dimuon branching fraction.

conditional_VMD_normalization_errors.meaning: Published |aS| extractions assume bS=0.4aS and an approximately negligible pion loop. The loop is retained here as an explicit small correction, without claiming a new fit. Vary |aS| and bS together at fixed sign and ratio. Statistical and systematic excursions remain separate; no combined confidence interval is invented.

unconstrained_shape_diagnostics.meaning: NA48/1 does not significantly determine bS. These two correlated central solutions are shape diagnostics, not independent Gaussian parameter errors, confidence bands or omitted-yield bounds. Do not treat the VMD normalization errors as covering this shape uncertainty.

pion_loop_authority.meaning: Historical measured K to 3pi inputs used by the published branching polynomials. The charged pi+pi- loop threshold is distinct from the neutral recoil-pion mass. Modern input updates and higher chiral orders are not supplied as measured errors.

explicit_conventions.lifetime_use: Explicit BR conversion convention only. A native source must pin its own lifetime and preserve its existing sampled flight; no native lifetime is changed by this card.

unqualified_terms: VMD is a benchmark shape; the broad correlated general fit does not define a unique spectrum.
No KL direct/indirect CP-violating amplitude or interference sign is inferred from this KS card.
The single-current model does not qualify scalar, axial, weak-Z or two-photon contributions.
Native parent flight, material attenuation, regeneration and secondary sources remain separate.
